NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 13, 9:50 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 23.6 DraftKings points for $8,100, against Arizona. Drake London (18.9, $7,000) and Chris Olave (17.8, $7,600) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.91 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 13, 9:50 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 6

Puka Nacua, LAR vs ARI ($8,100)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.6 DraftKings points at $8,100, the 5th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.7 points clear of Drake London. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 26.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.91 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 23.7 points with a simulated floor of 11.2 and a ceiling of 44.7, and he holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Drake London, ATL vs CHI ($7,000)

Drake London projects 2nd at the position with 18.9 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 24.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.70 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 38.2, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Chris Olave, NO at NYG ($7,600)

Chris Olave projects 3rd at the position with 17.8 DraftKings points at $7,600. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 35.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.34 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 30 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 37.4, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against the Giants, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Germie Bernard, PIT at TB ($4,000)

Germie Bernard projects for 10.0 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 2.50 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 30 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 4.2 targets on 17.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Bernard averaged 9.9 points with a simulated floor of 2.8 and a ceiling of 21.7, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Pittsburgh is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 39.5.
